name: 5sigmas agent tool catalog
description: Deterministic, evidence-backed AI engineering tools exposed to humans and browser agents.

tools.name: LLM Cost & Latency
tools.summary: Estimate cost per request, monthly spend, response time and average concurrency from token, cache, latency and traffic assumptions.

tools.name: Model Price/Performance
tools.summary: Compare model workload cost, benchmark signals, output speed, TTFT and context without collapsing provenance into one score.

tools.name: Inference VRAM
tools.summary: Estimate model-weight memory, KV cache, runtime reserve, per-GPU memory and approximate context or concurrency capacity.

tools.name: KV Cache & Context
tools.summary: Explore KV-cache memory across context length, concurrency, GQA/MQA, precision and an explicit memory budget.

tools.name: Transformer Attention
tools.summary: Manipulate attention scores, causal masking, softmax and values to inspect how one attention head forms its weighted output.

tools.name: Context Budget
tools.summary: Allocate a model context window across instructions, tools, history, RAG, user input, output reserve and safety headroom.

tools.name: RAG Retrieval Lab
tools.summary: Calculate Precision@k, Recall@k, MRR and nDCG on a visible ranking and test retrieval or reranking changes.

tools.name: RAG Evaluation
tools.summary: Evaluate context relevance, faithfulness, correctness and reference coverage with explicit labels, weights and uncertainty.

tools.name: Voice-Agent Latency
tools.summary: Break down time to first audio and barge-in across transport, turn detection, STT, model, TTS and buffering.

tools.name: Voice-Agent Cost & Capacity
tools.summary: Estimate monthly voice-agent spend, cost per call, billable units, workers and provider concurrency.

tools.name: Agent Reliability & Evaluation
tools.summary: Measure final success, first-pass success, retry recovery, tool decisions, operational incidences and trajectory efficiency against release gates.

tools.name: Prompt-Injection Threats
tools.summary: Defensively model paths from untrusted content to sensitive data, write-capable tools, egress and persistent memory with architectural controls.

tools.name: Benchmark Reliability
tools.summary: Inspect statistical resolution, saturation, invalid or potentially exposed items and ranking fragility under benchmark composition changes.

tools.name: Model Capability Timeline
tools.summary: Explore sourced model results over time with point-level provenance and explicit protocol breaks across multiple benchmarks.

tools.name: Scaling Laws
tools.summary: Reallocate a fixed training budget between parameters and tokens, inspect a Chinchilla-style conditional optimum and test exponent sensitivity.

tools.name: Training Compute & Energy
tools.summary: Estimate model FLOPs, runtime, facility power and energy from accelerator, MFU, power, PUE, parameter and token assumptions.

tools.name: Datacenter AI Capacity
tools.summary: Size an active accelerator fleet from facility power, PUE, installed slots, rack power and cooling constraints.

tools.name: Global AI Ecosystem
tools.summary: Compare country-level AI investment, company formation, infrastructure, model development, talent and policy signals with visible coverage and normalization.
